Nina Alvarez: Planning note: Redwood x AuroraLabs joint booth + evening demo session on 2024-09-14. Need run-of-show, demo owners, AV checklist, customs-safe swag list, and a returns plan.
Caleb Morris: I'll own the real-time ranking demo. Will provide perf slide + 30s clip.
Rina Sato: Marketing asks: co-branded landing + shortlink, speaker blurbs, and registrant cap. Recommend 400 live attendees.
Tom Becker: Logistics: AuroraLabs can ship 6 rigs but two have hot-swappable battery packs -> prefer to freight them. Need HS codes and MSDS by 2024-08-20.
Nina Alvarez: Swag: keep it customs-friendly (no batteries). Suggest 400 sticker packs + 100 cable organizers. Who manages post-event returns?
Rina Sato: Marketing will coordinate swag returns. We'll include return labels for demo loaners and a QR signup for post-event kits.
ops-bot: Created reminder "Upload HS codes + MSDS" for Tom on 2024-08-18.
Caleb Morris: Fallback plan: if on-site hardware delayed, demo falls back to Redwood hosted with a visible route-policy switch. I'll prepare a 1-min recorded fallback.
Tom Becker: Shipping cutoff to reach venue by 2024-09-10 is 2024-09-02 pickup. I'll confirm carrier and lead contact.
Rina Sato: AV needs: 2x HDMI capture, wired ethernet, one presenter lav, one handheld for Q&A, captions on. Please test captions during dry-run.
Nina Alvarez: Dry-run options: 2024-09-08 10:00 PT or 2024-09-11 16:00 PT. Which works?
Tom Becker: 09-11 16:00 PT works for AuroraLabs on-site engineer.
Nina Alvarez: Action items:
- Caleb: perf slide + fallback clip (due 2024-08-30)
- Tom: HS codes + MSDS + carrier contact (due 2024-08-18)
- Rina: landing + shortlink + swag returns plan (due 2024-08-25)
- Nina: finalize runbook + dry-run invite (due 2024-08-26)
Rina Sato: Legal/embargo? I'll flag if there are pricing callouts in the blurb.
Tom Becker: Will upload packing manifest and point person once carrier confirmed.
Nina Alvarez: Thanks all 680. I'll update the shared doc and ping before the dry-run.
